pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is it important to say tones correctly in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Because tones make the word longer
   B. Because tones are only used in writing
   C. Because tones are only for songs
   D. Because the tone can change the meaning of a word

2. Which of these is the first tone mark? (1 mark)
   A. A small V, as in ǎ
   B. A flat line, as in ā
   C. A falling line, as in à
   D. A rising line, as in á

3. Which Chinese word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. 谁 shéi
   B. 那 nà
   C. 妈妈 māma
   D. 妹妹 mèimei

4. Which Chinese word means "daughter"? (1 mark)
   A. 哥哥 gēge
   B. 有 yǒu
   C. 是 shì
   D. 女儿 nǚ'ér

5. What does 椅子 (yǐzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. In front of
   C. Chair
   D. Left side

6. What does 冰箱 (bīngxiāng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fridge
   B. Sofa
   C. Beside
   D. Left side

7. In the Swahili week, which day is counted as day 1? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Friday
   D. Sunday

8. Which Chinese word means "today"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 明天 míngtiān
   C. 休息 xiūxi
   D. 今天 jīntiān

9. Which Chinese word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 切 qiē
   B. 我们 wǒmen
   C. 礼物 lǐwù
   D. 大家 dàjiā

10. What does 号 (hào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. To play
   C. They
   D. Date (day of the month)

11. What is a tongue twister used for? (1 mark)
   A. To write characters
   B. To count numbers
   C. To tell time
   D. To practise clear and fluent pronunciation

12. Which Chinese word means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 吃 chī
   C. 肉 ròu
   D. 饼 bǐng

13. What does the broken telephone game teach? (1 mark)
   A. Careful listening
   B. Fast running
   C. Counting
   D. Drawing

14. Fill the blank: 我用耳朵____。 (I use my ears to hear.) (1 mark)
   A. 看
   B. 吃
   C. 说
   D. 听

15. What does 今天天气很好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Sunday
   B. The weather is very good today
   C. I am going to school
   D. It rains today

16. What is back-chaining? (1 mark)
   A. Building a long sentence from its end
   B. Writing backwards
   C. Singing a song
   D. Reading only the first word

17. Which sentence means "The door is on the left."? (1 mark)
   A. 门在左边。
   B. 椅子在桌子下。
   C. 冰箱在厨房。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

18. Which word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. 旁边
   B. 上面
   C. 里
   D. 下面

19. Which sentence means "My name is Xiaoming."? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢!
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 再见!
   D. 早上好!

20. Why do we read greetings with a friendly face? (1 mark)
   A. It changes the voice to sound friendly
   B. It makes the words longer
   C. It hides the words
   D. It changes the tones

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" and "Hello! (polite)" (4 marks)

22. Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head." (2 marks)

23. Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

24. Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences. (4 marks)

25. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 礼物 and 冰箱. (2 marks)

26. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea." (2 marks)

27. Describe how to say the initials b and p differently, and give one more pair like them. (4 marks)

28. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

29. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left." (2 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Because the tone can change the meaning of a word
   A different tone can mean a different word, such as mā and mǎ.

2. B — A flat line, as in ā
   The first tone is high and level, so its mark is a flat line.

3. C — 妈妈 māma
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

4. D — 女儿 nǚ'ér
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

5. C — Chair
   椅子 (yǐzi) means chair.

6. A — Fridge
   冰箱 (bīngxiāng) means fridge.

7. A — Saturday
   Jumamosi, Saturday, is day one, so Monday is day three (Jumatatu).

8. D — 今天 jīntiān
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

9. C — 礼物 lǐwù
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

10. D — Date (day of the month)
   号 (hào) means date (day of the month).

11. D — To practise clear and fluent pronunciation
   Tongue twisters practise hard sounds.

12. C — 肉 ròu
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

13. A — Careful listening
   A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

14. D — 听
   听 is to hear.

15. B — The weather is very good today
   天气 is weather and 很好 is very good.

16. A — Building a long sentence from its end
   You start with the last part and add one part at a time.

17. A — 门在左边。
   门在左边。 (mén zài zuǒbian.) means "The door is on the left.".

18. A — 旁边
   旁边 pángbiān is beside.

19. B — 我叫小明。
   我叫小明。 (wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.) means "My name is Xiaoming.".

20. A — It changes the voice to sound friendly
   A smile changes the sound of your voice.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo! 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: b is said without a puff of air and p with a puff of air. Another pair is d and t (or g and k). You can test with a paper strip, which moves more with p.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for b, 1 mark for p, 1 mark for another pair, 1 mark for the paper test or description.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
